rules.sampling: categorical from frozen batch policy; seed all applicable RNG; restore decision RNG before sampling
rules.task_sampling: each of 16 tasks once per epoch; equal task frequency, not equal source weighting; no score-based replacement
rules.traversal: sort SHA256 canonical [seed,epoch,task_id], tie task_id; identical geo/load sequence for the same seed
rules.batch: 8 whole-order attempts with immutable policy snapshot; update only after complete valid batch
rules.reward: 10 * actually successfully committed volume / fixed container volume; failed placement reward 0
rules.returns: disjoint chunks <=5; actual end-start length; each transition once; internal boundary bootstrap frozen V(next state)
rules.terminal: natural completion/empty pool/predicted instability ends trajectory, bootstrap 0; empty pool done attaches to prior valid transition
rules.truncated: explicit truncated=true and terminal=false; bootstrap next saved public state from collection snapshot; no fabricated terminal
rules.detach: targets/bootstrap detach; actor advantage detach; critic gradients through current values only
rules.singleton: actor weight 0; rewards/returns/critic retained; value-only forward counted separately, no policy-choice call
rules.empty: no forward on empty pool; whole batch zero valid transitions => NO_UPDATE and stop diagnostic
rules.finite: probabilities/loss/gradients/parameters must be finite; stop batch on violation
rules.technical_failure: stop batch and campaign, retain partial shard and all remaining NOT_RUN slots; no implicit retry or replacement
rules.denominators: all 6 models/12000 attempts/198000 action cap/1500 update slots retained; cancellation, incomplete, UNKNOWN_SEND, failure, NO_UPDATE distinct
rules.selection: fixed final epoch125 for all six seeds, no best-epoch/seed selection on evaluation
rules.metrics: per epoch complete/empty/instability/technical/unassessable/cancelled/not-run, full loading ratios, loss/value/entropy/gradient/time/cost; unknowns not zero
rules.resume: atomic model+Adam+all applicable RNG+update ID+policy snapshot+epoch/task/attempt/segment cursor+batch-shard refs; no old order re-signing
